# Active feature (topic) branches merged into `dev`, one per line.
# The Sync-upstream workflow re-merges each of these onto a freshly
# fast-forwarded `base` when syncing on the base fork (risin42/NagramX).
#
# Rules:
#   - one branch name per line, no `origin/` prefix (the workflow adds it)
#   - blank lines and `# comments` are ignored
#   - add a branch here when you first land it into `dev`
#   - remove it when you retire the feature, then rebuild `dev` (see the
#     nagramx-branch-flow skill)
#
# Example:
#   dazewell/chatlock
#   dazewell/hide-last-message
